free_tier.stated: A Free plan at USD 0 that publishes exactly one metered allowance: 5 commits a month, with basic features and community support. The page states no vCPU, memory, storage or wall-clock figure for the free plan, and Pro is USD 20 a month for unlimited commits.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: 5 commits a month with unpublished resources is a demo slot, not a host; the standby mode means a free workspace answers the first request after a restart delay, so it can serve a rarely visited page and nothing else.

limits.value: 5 commits a month is the published ceiling and there is no published compute allowance to spend it on, so a workspace that needs a sixth deploy waits for the next cycle.

evidence.proved: Free USD 0: '5 commits per month', basic features, community support; Pro USD 20/month for unlimited commits, quoted
free plans always run in the standby-when-unused deployment mode, where a workspace sleeps after about 60 minutes of inactivity and restarts on the next request, quoted
a free tier exists with a limit on how many free plan workspaces can run in parallel, quoted
